meta_title: Accept Crypto Tips as a Creator | Dynopay
meta_description: Accept crypto tips as a creator with your own personal tip page. Fans pay in Bitcoin, ETH, Solana & more—funds go directly to your wallet. Start free.
h1: Accept crypto tips as a creator with your personal tip page
subheading: Get your own dynopay.me/@handle where fans support you in Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and 15+ crypto assets—all sent directly to your wallet.
intro_paragraph: Creators and streamers who want to accept crypto tips face a choice: use custodial platforms that hold your funds, or build payment infrastructure yourself. Dynopay gives you a personal tip page at dynopay.me/@handle where fans send crypto directly to your wallet—no middleman custody, no chargebacks. You keep full control of every tip from Bitcoin to stablecoins across 15+ blockchains, with a flat 1.5% fee and no monthly costs.

features.title: Your funds, your wallet
features.description: Every tip lands directly in the crypto wallet you control. Dynopay never holds your money, so you can withdraw to an exchange or spend it whenever you want without waiting for payouts.

features.title: Fans tip in one tap
features.description: Your supporters visit your @handle page, pick an amount, and send crypto—no account creation required. They pay from any wallet, and you receive it in seconds or minutes depending on the blockchain.

features.title: Accept 15+ crypto assets
features.description: Receive tips in Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, USDT, USDC, Dogecoin, and more across 15+ blockchains. Fans pay with whatever crypto they already hold, so you never turn away support.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, and create your creator profile in under five minutes.
Add your crypto wallet address once—choose any chain you want to receive tips on.
Share your dynopay.me/@handle link everywhere you create content, and start receiving tips directly to your wallet.

faqs.question: How do creators accept crypto tips without losing custody?
faqs.answer: Dynopay generates a personal tip page at dynopay.me/@handle. When a fan tips you, the crypto goes directly from their wallet to yours. Dynopay routes the payment but never holds your funds, so you maintain full custody at all times.

faqs.question: What cryptocurrencies can I accept as tips on Dynopay?
faqs.answer: You can accept Bitcoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin, Ethereum, USDT and USDC on Ethereum and Polygon, RLUSD on Ethereum and XRP Ledger, TRX, USDT on Tron, Solana, XRP, and MATIC. Fans choose what to send; you receive it in your wallet.

faqs.question: Do my fans need to create an account to tip me in crypto?
faqs.answer: No. Fans visit your @handle page, select a tip amount, and send crypto from any wallet they already use. They don't sign up, log in, or share personal information—just send and done.

faqs.question: What fees does Dynopay charge for crypto tips?
faqs.answer: Dynopay charges 1.5% per successful tip, plus a small fixed fee of one dollar for tips under one hundred dollars. No monthly fees, no setup costs, no hidden charges. You see exactly what you'll receive before sharing your page.

faqs.question: How long does it take to start accepting crypto tips as a creator?
faqs.answer: Under ten minutes. Sign up, verify your email, add your wallet address, and get your personal tip page link. Share your dynopay.me/@handle on stream, in your bio, or anywhere you create content and start receiving tips immediately.

cta_headline: Create your tip page in minutes
cta_body: Set up your personal crypto tip page today and start receiving support directly to your wallet with no monthly fees or setup costs
